  • Method Details

    • gameConfig

      public void gameConfig(String playerNickname, PlayerColor playerColor, int level, int numPlayers) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Configures the game's initial settings based on the provided parameters.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player initiating the configuration
      playerColor - the color chosen by the player
      level - the difficulty level of the game
      numPlayers - the total number of players participating in the game
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the current state does not allow game configuration
      IllegalArgumentException - if any of the provided parameters are invalid

    • addNewPlayer

      public void addNewPlayer(String playerNickname, PlayerColor playerColor) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Adds a new player to the current game state with the specified nickname and color.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the unique nickname of the player to be added
      playerColor - the color representing the player in the game
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the current state does not allow adding a new player
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided arguments are invalid or violate game rules

    • selectDeselectSubdeck

      public ConstructionDeckDTO selectDeselectSubdeck(String player, Integer selectedDeck, Boolean isSelectAction) throws IllegalStateException
      Selects or deselects a subdeck for a specified player based on the provided parameters.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player performing the action
      selectedDeck - the identifier of the subdeck to be selected or deselected
      isSelectAction - a boolean indicating whether to select (true) or deselect (false) the subdeck
      Returns:
      a ConstructionDeckDTO representing the updated selection state of the subdeck
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the action is not allowed in the current state

    • selectTile

      public ConstructionComponentDTO selectTile(String player, Integer id) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Selects a tile for the specified player based on the provided tile ID.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player performing the tile selection
      id - the unique ID of the tile to be selected
      Returns:
      a ConstructionComponentDTO representing the tile that was selected
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the tile selection action is not permitted in the current state
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided player identifier or tile ID is invalid

    • deselectTile

      public ConstructionComponentDTO deselectTile(String player, Integer id) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Deselects a tile for the specified player based on the provided tile ID.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player performing the tile deselection
      id - the unique ID of the tile to be deselected
      Returns:
      a ConstructionComponentDTO representing the tile that was deselected
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the tile deselection action is not permitted in the current state
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided player identifier or tile ID is invalid

    • reserveTile

      public ReservedComponentDTO reserveTile(String player, Integer id) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Reserves a tile for the specified player based on the provided tile ID.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player performing the tile reservation
      id - the unique ID of the tile to be reserved
      Returns:
      a ConstructionComponentDTO representing the tile that was reserved
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the tile reservation action is not permitted in the current state
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided player identifier or tile ID is invalid

    • fastShip

      public FastShipDTO fastShip(String playerNickname) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Performs the "fast ship" action for the specified player.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - the nickname of the player executing the fast shipping action
      Returns:
      a FastShipDTO encapsulating the details of the fast shipping operation
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the action is not permitted in the current state
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided player nickname is invalid

    • placeTile

      public PlacedComponentDTO placeTile(String player, Integer componentID, Integer i, Integer j, Integer rotation)
      Places a tile in the game at the specified location with the given orientation.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player placing the tile
      componentID - the unique identifier of the tile to be placed
      i - the row index where the tile will be placed
      j - the column index where the tile will be placed
      rotation - the rotation of the tile to be placed
      Returns:
      a PlacedComponentDTO object representing the details of the placed tile
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if placing the tile is not allowed in the current state

    • playerEndedSendShip

      public PlayerEndedShipDTO playerEndedSendShip(String player, int reservedTiles) throws IllegalStateException
      Handles the action of a player ending the ship construction phase.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player executing the action
      reservedTiles - the number of tiles reserved and unused by the player during the construction phase
      Returns:
      a PlayerEndedShipDTO object containing details about the player's action
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the action is not permitted in the current state

    • flipTimer

      public TimerDTO flipTimer(String player) throws IllegalStateException
      Flips the timer in the ship construction phase, if it's flippable.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player attempting to flip the timer
      Returns:
      a TimerDTO representing the state of the timer after the flip action
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the flip action is not permitted in the current state

    • fixShip

      public FixedComponentDTO fixShip(String player, Integer i, Integer j) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Attempts to remove a ship component at the specified location for the given player.
      Parameters:
      player - the identifier of the player attempting to fix the ship
      i - the row index of the ship component to be removed
      j - the column index of the ship component to be removed
      Returns:
      a FixedComponentDTO containing details about the removed ship component
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided parameters are invalid or the action cannot be performed

      lifeformToAdd - the lifeform component to be added to the ship
      Returns:

      Throws:

    • playCard

      public List<CardRoundDTO> playCard(ActionJSON action) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Executes the play card action based on the provided parameters.
      Parameters:
      action - the action request details encapsulated within an ActionJSON object
      Returns:
      a list of CardRoundDTO objects representing the results of the executed action: if the list contains one element, it is the updated state of the current card; if it contains two elements, the second is the new card that needs to be played.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided action parameters are invalid or not allowed

    • handlePlayerDisconnection

      public void handlePlayerDisconnection(String player)
      Handles the disconnection of a player during the ShipConstructionState, freeing any resources locked by the player. In particular, if the player has selected a subdeck, it will be deselected to allow other players to use it.
      Parameters:
      player - the username of the player who has disconnected

    • onComplete

      public abstract void onComplete()
      Executes the state transition when the game is ready, preventing new commands when the game needs to update its phase. This method is used by most commands to safely advance the game to the next state.

    • generateState

      public StateDTO generateState()
      Generates and returns a new state representation as a StateDTO object, setting the state name to the string representation of the current object. Each concrete state implementation provides its own version of this method.
      Returns:
      a StateDTO object encapsulating the state details
